definitions.full: H1041. Beth -azmaveth בֵּיתעַֿזְמָ֫וֶת proper name, of a location near Jerusalem Neh 7:28 = עַזְמָ֫וֶת Ezra 2:24 & עַזְמָ֑וֶת Neh 12:29 ; compare 1Chr 12:13 (where proper name, masculine); — modern El-„izmeh approximately 5 miles north-northeast of Jerusalem according to Ritter Geogr. xvi. 519 Survey iii. 9 .
